0022600213.text: The LA Clippers (1-7, 1-3 at home, 0-4 on the road, on a seven-game losing streak) visit the Phoenix Suns (3-5, 3-2 at home, on a two-game winning streak), with the Clippers 13th in the West and the Suns 12th. Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Isaiah Jackson (groin soreness), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery) are out for the Clippers, while Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) is out for Phoenix. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Clippers won the most recent meeting 117-93 in Phoenix on February 1, 2026, with no games yet between them this season.
